statement: For the exact orbit D^[V]_(V-12)=0 and D^[V]_(q-1)=V+KK_q(D^[V]_q), define W_r(V)=D^[V]_(r+2)-binom(V-12,r+2)-binom(V-13,r+1). For every integer V>=125: (i) 0<=W_r(V)<binom(V-13,r) for each 7<=r<=14; and (ii) W_14(V+1)-W_14(V)<=1.
closes: Together with the exact 40<=V<=125 bridge, this high-rank lemma implies W_6(V+1)-W_6(V)<binom(V-13,5) for every V>=125 and hence D_8<binom(V-11,8) for every V>=40.
It would close the local all-V rank-eight interface only; inherited construction replay is still required for any scoped upper-bound promotion, and it does not determine exact n_0(r).
